milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the smooth sandstone structure and be close enough to visually identify it. The target is the approximate center of the structure at spawn-relative (1, 1, 9). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the structure (not just standing at spawn ~6 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished diorite slab with a pickaxe causes the item to drop and enter the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_diorite_slab in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. A wooden pickaxe (provided in scene) is sufficient to mine stone-type blocks and get proper drops.
